open_regression.cause: render-blocking CSS chunk grew to 106KB (26KB gz) because 92 @font-face rules moved into the critical CSS bundle; next/font previously inlined+preloaded them off the critical path. open_regression.possible_fix: load pretendard-subset.css non-render-blocking (safe because display:optional tolerates late font), and/or defer GA.
